meta_title: Lindsey Williams Home and Gardens | Gardener Southampton
meta_description: Lindsey Williams Home and Gardens offers professional gardening and garden design across Southampton. Expert care for your outdoor space. Call today.
hero_subhead: Transform your outdoor space with expert gardening, maintenance, and design tailored to Southampton homes.
services_subhead: From regular maintenance to full garden redesigns, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly upkeep including lawn mowing, hedge trimming, and weeding. Keep your garden looking immaculate year-round without the hard work.

services.title: Garden Design and Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space and budget. We handle full landscaping projects, from new borders to patio installation.

services.title: Hedge and Tree Pruning
services.desc: Professional pruning and shaping to promote healthy growth and maintain shape. Safe removal of overgrown or hazardous specimens.

services.title: Lawn Care and Restoration
services.desc: Expert lawn treatment, aeration, and seeding. Restore patchy or tired lawns to lush, healthy grass in a single season.

services.title: Seasonal Tidy-Ups and Clearance
services.desc: Spring and autumn garden preparation, leaf clearance, and waste removal. Leave the heavy lifting to us.

services.title: Planting and Garden Features
services.desc: Expert planting schemes, raised beds, pergolas, and water features. Add colour and structure to your garden.

about_pullquote: A well-kept garden transforms how you feel about your home every single day.
about_para_1: Lindsey Williams started her gardening business in 2008 with a simple mission: to give Southampton homeowners back their weekends. What began as one woman and a van has grown into a trusted local service with hundreds of happy customers. Every project is treated with the same care and attention—whether it's a weekly lawn cut or a complete garden redesign.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we show up on time, and we genuinely care about your garden's health and beauty. We're not interested in cutting corners or overselling services you don't need. Over nearly two decades, we've built our reputation on straightforward pricing, reliable work, and real expertise.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Lindsey transformed our overgrown back garden into something we actually use now. She listened to what we wanted, came back with a brilliant design, and the whole job was done on time and within budget. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Been using Lindsey for regular maintenance for three years now. Reliable, professional, and genuinely knows her plants. She spotted a problem with our roses before it got serious. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Called Lindsey last minute for help clearing our garden after winter. She squeezed us in, worked quickly, and left everything tidy. No fuss, fair price, and she even advised what to plant for spring.
reviews.author: Janet M.
